source_note: Plan, prediction file and this script were untracked working-tree files at that commit.

definitions.coordinate: projection of the state on the segment between the two reference cycles at the hold, phase by phase: 0 on cycle 0, 1 on cycle 1
definitions.passage_update: first update from which the coordinate stays beyond the level three quarters of the way to the requested cycle for six consecutive updates; also reported at one quarter and one half
definitions.update_reaching_hold_unstable_orbit: update, sampled at the branch's saved phase and interpolated linearly between two samples, at which the coordinate first passes the projection of the hold's unstable orbit
definitions.displacement: norm of x(n+6) - x(n) during the endpoint stage
definitions.bottleneck: smallest displacement at each phase before the passage, refined by a three-point parabola when the minimum is interior

scope: Saved trajectories of fixed pilot grids from one model at one hold. The write-1 predictions use a coefficient taken from the companion study's multipliers near the fold; the nominal write-1 passage was already known approximately when the method was fixed. The write-0 line is a two-parameter fit. Not a located bifurcation beyond the receipts named in the plan, not a basin, not a reliability estimate.
